modules.label: Configure ACS image integrations
modules.runSummary: Central OpenShift: read the pull-secret. Central API: upsert Quay, registry.redhat.io, and GAR image integrations and test them.
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: remove the image integrations this module created. Does not change the cluster pull-secret.

modules.label: ACS Cosign / signature integration (Red Hat Public)
modules.runSummary: Central API: create or update the Red Hat Public Cosign / signature integration.
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: delete the Red Hat Public signature integration.

modules.label: Compliance Operator (OLM) + Central CIS scan schedule
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster(s): install Compliance Operator (OLM). Central API: merge those clusters into scan schedule ocp4-cis-scan-schedule.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster(s): remove Compliance Operator. Central API: drop those clusters from the CIS schedule (schedule kept if others remain).

modules.label: Deploy OCP Virt + RHEL VMs for ACS guest vulnerability demo
modules.runSummary: Central OpenShift: enable ROX_VIRTUAL_MACHINES on the Central CR. Secured cluster: enable SecuredCluster flags, install OpenShift Virtualization, deploy two RHEL 9 VMs with roxagent. Central API: wait until guest CVEs appear.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: delete project acs-virt-demo (the VMs). Leaves CNV and ACS virtual-machine flags in place.

modules.label: Mostmark microservices (project ms-demo)
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster(s): create project ms-demo and apply the Online Boutique microservices manifests.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster(s): delete project ms-demo and wait until it is gone.

modules.label: Init-container Clean/Dirty/Blue/Red (acs-init-container-test)
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster(s): deploy clean/dirty/blue/red apps in acs-init-container-test. Central API: create the three DEMO-Init-Test policies.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster(s): delete project acs-init-container-test. Central API: remove the DEMO-Init-Test policies.

modules.label: Users Part 1 (OCP)
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: create HTPasswd users adam/boaz/chris, IdP, and adam cluster-admin. Namespace admin for boaz/chris is applied when ms-demo / init-demo projects exist (safe to run before those demos).
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove those HTPasswd users / IdP pieces and related RBAC. Does not undo Parts 2–3 in Central.

modules.label: Users Part 2 (OAuth)
modules.runSummary: Central API: configure OpenShift OAuth / auth provider wiring for the demo users (after Part 1).
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: remove the OAuth / auth provider configuration this module added.

modules.label: Users Part 3 (ACS)
modules.runSummary: Central API: create ACS roles and access scopes so adam, boaz, and chris see the intended views.
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: remove the ACS roles and access scopes this module created.

modules.label: Central Slack integration
modules.runSummary: Central API: create or update the Slack notifier (lab webhook) and attach it to every DEMO policy.
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: delete the Slack notifier. DEMO policies remain.

modules.label: Implements a Syslog CEF receiver and provides a log parser UI
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: deploy acs-syslog-demo (CEF receiver, LoadBalancer, viewer Route). Central API: create or update the Syslog notifier to that endpoint and run Central Test.
modules.uninstallSummary: Central API: delete the Syslog notifier. Secured cluster: delete namespace acs-syslog-demo (when that target is selected).

modules.label: Splunk Operator + RHACS Technology Add-on
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: install Splunk Operator, Free Standalone, Web Route, and the RHACS Splunk TA from the local .spl. Central is wired later in the Splunk UI (not in this run).
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: delete the Splunk Standalone, Helm release, and demo namespace. Leaves cluster-scoped CRDs.

modules.label: Installs/updates an OpenShift MCP server on your cluster and wires it to your preferred AI agent
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: install or update the OpenShift MCP server and wire it for your AI agent.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove the OpenShift MCP server footprint.

modules.label: Launches an MCP gateway on the cluster you designate
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: launch or update the MCP gateway.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove the MCP gateway.

modules.label: Configures OpenShift Lightspeed integration
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: configure OpenShift Lightspeed pieces for ACS. Central API: complete Lightspeed integration on the selected targets.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove Lightspeed pieces this module owns. Central API: remove the related Central wiring.

modules.label: Installs/updates an ACS MCP server on your cluster and wires it to your agent
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: install or update the ACS MCP server and wire it to your agent.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove the ACS MCP server footprint.

modules.label: Install Prometheus on your cluster and wire ACS monitoring
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: enable or configure Prometheus / user-workload monitoring. Central API: wire ACS monitoring on the selected targets.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove Prometheus / monitoring pieces this module owns. Central API: remove related ACS monitoring wiring.

modules.label: Install Hashi on your cluster, enable External Secret Management Console plugin, External Secrets Operator (ESO) and a demo application
modules.runSummary: Secured cluster: install Vault and External Secrets Operator pieces, enable the console plugin, and deploy the demo application.
modules.uninstallSummary: Secured cluster: remove the Vault / ESO / demo app footprint this module owns.
